notes.title: Game Launch & Localization Plans
notes.notes:
We are delighted to have successfully launched 'The Sleep Experiment,' our first independently released game. We are fully aware that there is room for improvement and, as such, we will continue to work on it and make enhancements based on your feedback, which will also aid us in the development of future games. Additionally, we are excited to announce that we will soon be adding localization in the following languages: Chinese, French, Spanish, Russian, and German.

Thank You,
Team ClawsDev
